title: Lead Software Engineer / Tech Lead, Growth (Remote)
description:
Fully Remote (North America / South America)

  • There is 1 opening, posted to multiple locations.
  • No agencies.
About Maximus

Maximus ( is a mission-driven consumer performance medicine telehealth company that provides men and women with content, community, and clinical support to optimize their health, wellness, and hormones. Maximus has achieved profitability, 8‑figure ARR, and is doubling year over year – with a strong cash position. We have raised $15M from top Silicon Valley VCs such as Founders Fund and 8VC as well as leading angel investors/operators from companies like Bulletproof, Tinder, Coinbase, Daily Stoic, & Shopify. We also offer Maximus Labs, a standalone biomarker testing subscription that doubles as an acquisition channel into our telemedicine protocols. We’re targeting 2× customer growth this year and need a Growth Lead who can build the acquisition engine that gets us there. We’re capital‑efficient and compete against Hims, Hone, Keeps, and Fella by being better at the product, not louder with ad spend. Our growth strategy is conversion‑driven: make the signup‑to‑checkout funnel so good that paid channels become more efficient by default.

About The Role

We are looking for a strong Lead Engineer (Tech Lead) to lead our Growth engineering team. You will be splitting your time roughly 50/50 between management and coding. You own the lower acquisition funnel, from flow start through checkout, across all Maximus protocols. Your north star metric is Flow Start to Checkout CVR. You also carry an M1 Retention guardrail, which means you can’t optimize for conversion at the expense of user quality. Every experiment you ship has a built‑in quality check. You will manage a small team of engineers and work directly with a Sr. PM and Sr. Designer. You will report directly to the Head of Engineering.

Why this role and join us?
  • Impact: Set the technical direction for how Maximus acquires customers, run experiments that directly move revenue, and build a team that compounds learning over time. The Growth team's output is visible in the company’s top‑line numbers every month.
  • First 90 days: Complete BNPL migration to Klarna across all protocols.
  • First 2 Quarters: Launch a new activation satisfaction survey for our retention guardrail and build cohort‑level experiment tracking.
  • Maximus is at the stage where the acquisition engine needs a dedicated engineering leader who stays with the problem long enough to compound results. If you want to own that end to end, with real authority and real accountability, this is the role for you.
What You Will Do (Key Responsibilities)
  • Deliver protocol‑level A/B experiments on signup flows, checkout, plan pricing, and product recommendations using Amplitude.
  • Ship full‑stack features across the acquisition funnel in Rails and React.
  • Coach and develop your engineering team through regular 1:1s, pair programming, code reviews, and career conversations.
  • Own experiment design, including sample sizing, metric selection, and the CVR‑vs‑retention tension that comes with a dual mandate.
  • Iterate and continuously optimize plan and pricing architecture, including payment platform integrations.
  • Build and maintain the experimentation infrastructure your team runs on.
  • Partner with data engineering to instrument cohort‑level M1 retention tracking per experiment.
  • Drive adoption of AI‑assisted development across the team, using tools like Claude Code and Devin to increase shipping and development velocity.
Our Tech Stack
  • Ruby on Rails 7 / Ruby 3.3, React 18 / TypeScript 5.4 (strongly preferred)
  • Event‑sourced architecture with command pattern
  • PostgreSQL, Redis, Delayed Job for background processing
  • Stripe and Klarna for payments and installment plans
  • Amplitude for experimentation and analytics, Segment for event collection
  • Redux with redux‑loop and Immutable.js on the frontend
  • Docker, AWS/GCP, Aptible, GitHub Actions CI/CD
  • Cypress for E2E testing
  • AI‑assisted development: Claude Code and Devin for agentic coding
What We Are Looking For (Qualifications)
  • You’ve led a team of 4‑8 engineers before, with direct reports you grew and retained.
  • You’ve shipped and measured growth experiments in a subscription product (signup funnels, checkout optimization, pricing and plan architecture).
  • You write production Ruby on Rails and React code and expect to keep doing so (strongly preferred). JavaScript (Node), Python are also acceptable.
  • You can design an experiment, pick the right metric, set a sample size, and explain the trade‑offs to a PM who wants to ship faster.
  • You think in funnels and cohorts, not just features.
  • You’re comfortable with event‑sourced systems or similar architectural patterns where state is derived from event streams.
  • You use agentic AI coding tools (Claude Code, Devin, Cursor, or similar) in your daily workflow and have opinions about how to integrate them into a team’s development process.
Nice To Have (strongly Preferred)
  • Experience with healthcare, wellness, or regulated subscription commerce.
  • Familiarity with Stripe billing, Klarna, or similar payment platform integrations.
  • Experience building or managing Amplitude (or LaunchDarkly, Optimizely, etc.) experimentation infrastructure.
How We Work
  • Remote, Americas‑based (team is distributed across US and Latin America time zones).
  • Two‑week sprints with PM, Design, and Tech Lead driving prioritization together.
  • Ship and deploy to production multiple times per day.
World‑Class Benefits
  • Full suite: health, medical, dental coverage (USA & Canada).
  • Flexible vacation/time‑off policies.
  • Equity into the company in the form of high‑potential stock options.
  • Liquidity of options whenever available.
  • Extended options exercise window for loyal employees (3 months for every year of service; e.g. 1 year for 4+ year employees).
Interview process

Do you believe you’re a fit for this role and want to join the Maximus team? We’d love to hear about you! Here is what you can expect from the hiring process (if there are changes we will be sure to let you know).

  • Application & Criteria Questionnaire: When submitting your application and resume, tell us why you want to join Maximus and take your time with the questions. The Criteria Questionnaire will be sent to you automatically and is mandatory, we will use it as part of our data‑driven process. This is your chance to make a strong first impression.
  • First Interview (30min): Interview with Justin L, Recruiting Lead. This will be an exploratory conversation focused on how you work, your experience & fit for the role, and alignment on values and expectations.
  • Hiring Manager Interview (60min): You will then meet with Mark P – Head of Engineering to understand how you would approach real Growth team problems across system design and technical decisions as well as discussion around leading a team, growing engineers, hiring, AI adoption, and other aspects of people leadership.
  • Technical Interview (60min): Interview with one of our Senior or Lead engineers to evaluate hands‑on coding ability in our stack (Rails + React/TypeScript). We want to see that you can build and ship, not just architect. Feel free to use agentic AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, etc.) during the exercise, as appropriate.
  • Product Interview (45min): You will chat with Steve C – Senior Growth Product Manager who will dive into your collaboration with product, how you assess trade‑offs, and growth related product work.
  • Meet the CEO (30min): At the very end, you will have the opportunity to meet with Cam S, our CEO. This is a great chance for you to gain a deeper understanding of Maximus’s strategy, values, and work processes.

Maximus is an equal opportunity employer, which not only includes standard protected categories, but the additional freedom from discrimination against your free speech and beliefs, as long as they are aligned with company values. We celebrate intellectual diversity.

Note: We utilize AI note‑taking technology during our interview sessions to ensure we capture all answers and details accurately. Candidates are also encouraged to use AI note‑takers for their own records if they wish.

title: Senior Legal Counsel
description:
Wärtsilä is a world leader in marine technology and leading the industry's transformation towards a decarbonised and sustainable future. With the world’s widest portfolio and service network, we – Wärtsilians - deliver efficient, safe and sustainable integrated products and solutions to enhance the business of our customers. The opportunities presented through digitalisation and new technologies are offering a new era of shipping. Did you know that shipping is the world’s most efficient mode of transportation and that 88% of the world's trade is carried by sea?

We want to change the course towards an interconnected and cleaner maritime future and are constantly on the lookout for future‑oriented talent to join our team and to work towards enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services - together. Are you ready to jump onboard?

Would you like to be part of Wärtsilä’s journey to decarbonize the maritime industry? Marine Legal & Compliance supports Wärtsilä’s Marine businesses by enabling growth, safeguarding the business, and upholding trust. The team works across the full contract lifecycle and helps the business balance commercial opportunity with legal, compliance, financial, operational, and reputational risk. This role will serve as a senior regional legal partner for Latin America, with a strong focus on commercial contracting, compliance‑sensitive transactions, dispute prevention and handling, and business partnering across sales, delivery, lifecycle, and selected strategic initiatives.

Main Responsibilities
  • Draft, review, structure, and negotiate complex commercial agreements in support of Marine businesses, including project sales, equipment delivery, lifecycle/service agreements, framework agreements, amendments, NDAs, notices, and other legal documentation.
  • Provide practical, solutions‑oriented legal advice to business stakeholders in Latin America across the full contract lifecycle, including pre‑bid, bid, negotiation, execution, delivery, claims, and disputes.
  • Act as the primary legal business partner for matters involving customers and opportunities in Latin America.
  • Support negotiation strategy and escalation analysis under Marine Legal & Compliance policies, including use of contract templates, GTCs, approval matrices, and deviation processes.
  • Partner closely with Sales, Project Delivery, lifecycle/service teams, business control, risk, compliance, trade compliance, safety, cyber, data privacy, sourcing, and other internal stakeholders to ensure that legal and compliance considerations are addressed in commercial activities.
  • Advise on cross‑border and public‑sector / state‑owned‑customer transactions in the region, including risk allocation, liability, subcontracting, assignment, delivery, compliance, and procurement‑related issues.
  • Support compliance and integrity initiatives relevant to the region, including anti‑corruption, Know Your Business Partner / third‑party risk, Code of Conduct, and related awareness‑building.
  • Contribute to legal training, template development, continuous improvement, and simplification of contracting processes, and help business teams understand when and how to involve Marine Legal & Compliance.
  • Provide legal support in strategic areas relevant to Marine’s current priorities, including decarbonisation, new fuels, regulatory implementation, safety, and selected digital/cyber/data issues as they arise in regional transactions.
Required Qualifications
  • Qualified to practice law in Brazil or, alternatively, in the relevant jurisdiction of hire.
  • LL.M. degree required.
  • Strong post‑graduation legal experience as a practicing attorney at a reputable law firm, and preferably as in‑house counsel.
  • Strong experience drafting and negotiating sophisticated commercial agreements in Portuguese and English; ability to also draft and negotiate in Spanish is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to advise business stakeholders independently, negotiate high‑complexity matters, and balance legal protection with commercial practicality.
Preferred Experience
  • Experience supporting marine, industrial equipment, lifecycle/service, energy, oil & gas, infrastructure, or other technically complex B2B sectors.
  • Experience with Latin American civil‑law jurisdictions, especially Brazil and broader South/Central America.
  • Experience with public procurement / government‑related counterparties, state‑owned entities, or other regulated counterparties.
  • Familiarity with anti‑corruption, third‑party risk / KYBP, data/privacy, trade compliance, cyber/security‑related clauses, and policy‑based contract governance.
  • Experience delivering internal training, building playbooks/templates, and working in a policy‑driven contracting environment.
What Success Looks Like In This Role
  • Trusted legal partner to Marine stakeholders in Latin America.
  • Strong, business‑facing negotiator who can lead matters independently in Portuguese and English, and preferably Spanish.
  • Able to identify the big picture quickly, understand the contract and the business need, assess legal/commercial/compliance risk, involve the right stakeholders, and move matters forward pragmatically.
  • Collaborative, commercially minded, solution‑oriented, and comfortable operating in a matrixed global organization.
Why join us

You will join a highly capable global legal and compliance team that plays a central role in supporting Wärtsilä Marine’s commercial, compliance, and decarbonisation agenda. Marine Legal & Compliance works at the intersection of contracting, technology, regulation, safety, and strategic business partnering, with opportunities to contribute meaningfully to both regional business execution and wider global initiatives.

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Basic Function

Incumbent serves as a member of the president’s cabinet and senior management team with authority over a wide range of policy issues; organizational, management and technical assignments, and special projects that may be on-going or non-recurring in nature. The individual will also oversee the management of the staff assigned to the Office of the President and its unique functions.

Dimensions

Supervise the work of office staff, professionals, consultants and students. Manage and organize priority projects, initiatives, and workflow for the Office of the President.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include the Board of Trustees, President, executives, administrators, faculty, students, and staff of the university. External contacts include parents, consultants, auditors, government officials, representatives from financial institutions, investment managers, law firms, alumni, donors, representatives from other colleges and universities, visitors and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities
  • The Chief of Staff is responsible for overseeing and directing the operations of the President’s Office providing executive level support to the President serving as a senior advisor with regard to policy formulation, alternative and option analysis, and ensuring the decisions of the president are implemented in a timely manner and in accordance with direction given.
  • The Chief of staff represents the president’s position to internal and external stakeholders on matters of university policy and practice and serves as the president’s liaison to various University-related committees. The Chief of Staff also consistently interfaces with the President’s Cabinet to ensure that key issues are being proactively addressed.
  • The Chief of Staff will manage the flow of communication in and out of the President’s office to ensure consistent and responsive message delivery to key University stakeholders, including faculty, staff, students, alumni and other external constituents as appropriate.
  • Assist in planning (including strategic planning) and developing and establishing policies and goals consistent with organizational objectives and governmental regulations.
  • Generate, schedule, track, and coordinate assignments, as needed across stakeholder groups. Work independently to complete assignments involving the appropriate internal or external contacts.
  • Coordinate comprehensive projects and assignments that require collaboration of several different offices and/or areas of the University including personnel/management reviews, and special studies.
  • Prepare agendas for each Cabinet or other executive meetings and provide a summary of discussions and action items resulting from each meeting to attendees, ensuring appropriate follow-up as required.
  • Conduct data analysis, research, and write reports for use in executive decision-making. Handle data, communication and projects that are highly privileged and confidential.
  • Provide leadership in the development and administration of University or division-wide integrated plans and processes, i.e., accreditation assessments and performance evaluation reviews.
  • Build and maintain mutually supportive relationships with all levels of management, staff, outside agencies and vendors, when necessary. Work to remove barriers that hamper inter-and intra-department communications. Coordinate and monitor assignments which must be accomplished in conjunction with other senior executives.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.
Core Competencies
  • Comprehensive knowledge of the principles, practices and methods employed in senior and executive level management.
  • Keen and demonstrated understanding of higher education structures, systems, strategies, policies, and procedures.
  • Computer and Internet research skills (including Microsoft Office Suite; spreadsheet, and presentation)
  • Skill in management and leadership with the ability to direct programs, staff, and cross-functional teams in an efficient and effective manner.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skill including tact, patience, and acumen and the ability to work with many, diverse individuals across various functions.
  • Excellent organizational and analytical skill and ability to formulate recommendations.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills including correspondence writing, professional presentation development.
  • Ability to prioritize work follow-through with meticulous attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to use a great deal of initiative work effectively under pressure and handle multiple simultaneous tasks and demands.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious relations with students, faculty, staff, University officials and the general public.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced environment; and commitment to completing tasks to the highest standards.
  • Highest level of integrity and management of confidential information
Minimum Requirements

Master’s Degree in Business/Public Administration or related field, and 7 years of relevant experience or an equivalent combination of 10 years combined relevant training and experience.

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visam diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Como Engenheiro de Automação Especialista, sua missão será fornecer suporte técnico e resolver problemas em sistemas de controle e automação e, apoio as disciplinas e Instrumentação e Telecomunicações em toda frota PRIO, além de monitorar e auditar manutenções em controladores, servidores, instrumentos e sensores. Além disso, você também deverá garantir a integridade dos ativos de automação, assegurando a conformidade com as melhores práticas de gestão e atualizações de hardware e software. Além disso, você será responsável por realizar estudos conceituais para modificações, conduzir análises de causa raiz (RCA) para falhas, supervisionar comissionamento e start-up de sistemas críticos, e revisar propostas técnicas para aquisição de novos sistemas e componentes.

#LI-DS1

#LI-ONSITE

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Fornecer suporte técnico e resolução de problemas em sistemas de controle, automação, instrumentação e telecomunicações das unidades operadas;

  • Garantir a integridade e aplicação das melhores práticas para gestão dos ativos de automação (hardware e software), atendendo aos requisitos de vida útil, obsolescência e atualizações;
  • Realizar estudos conceituais para modificações em sistemas de controle, automação, instrumentação e telecomunicações das unidades operadas;
  • Revisar tecnicamente propostas para aquisição de sistemas e componentes;
  • Supervisionar comissionamento e start-up de sistemas críticos;

  • Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Eletrônica, Controle e Automação ou áreas correlatas;

  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento e manutenção de sistemas de supervisão (Siemens, ABB e Rockwell);
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em redes industriais e seus principais protocolos de comunicação (Profibus, Modbus, Ethernet-IP, OPC, entre outras);
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em instrumentação industrial (troubleshooting, calibração e especificação);
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em controles PID e sintonia de malhas;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em sistemas de detecção de fogo e gás.
Informações adicionais

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.
  • Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.
  • Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Resumo do Perfil do Cargo

The Fiscal Compliance Supervisor leads and oversees all tax and fiscal compliance activities for Brazil Operations. Responsibilities include reviewing tax calculations and ensuring the timely submission of all required declarations at the federal, state, and municipal levels, as well as filings with BACEN, IBGE, and other regulatory or statistical entities. This role safeguards full compliance, maintains good standing certifications, and ensures adherence to applicable legislation, special tax or customs regimes, and customer contract requirements. The position partners closely with Management and Statutory Accounting, Corporate Tax, Treasury, Intercompany, Supply Chain (Logistics and Procurement), and HR (Payroll and Employment Tax) to ensure accurate tax treatment and compliance across key processes, including equipment movement, payroll burdens, and PIT (IRRF) obligations. The role also manages outsourced service providers, supports audits and inspections, and leads the local fiscal compliance sub team in applying best practices and meeting all statutory deadlines.

Descrição do Cargo Key Roles & Responsibilities
  • Tax & Fiscal Compliance Execution - Review and validate federal, state, and municipal tax calculations (IRPJ/CSLL, PIS/COFINS, ICMS, ISS, IBS, CBS, IS, IPTU, etc.). Ensure the timely submission of all statutory declarations (SPEDs, DCTF, EFDs, DIRF equivalent filings, municipal returns, and nota fiscal issuance/collection). Coordinate regulatory filings with the IRS, BACEN, IBGE, and other government or statistical entities. Maintain full compliance with legislation, special tax or customs regimes (e.g., REPETRO and specific ICMS treatments), and customer contract obligations.
  • Cross Functional Compliance Support - Partner with Supply Chain to ensure compliant equipment, goods, and asset movement, including ICMS compliance, nota fiscal issuance, and proper supporting documentation. Support HR in payroll tax compliance, including social burdens (INSS and FGTS) and PIT/IRRF obligations. Collaborate with Management and Statutory Accounting teams on tax accounting in corporate and local ledgers, including P&L provisioning and actuals, balance sheet reconciliations, and budget/forecast preparation for General Taxes. Work with Corporate Tax, Treasury, Legal and Intercompany teams to ensure correct tax treatment across all business processes.
  • Governance, Controls & Risk Management - Maintain internal controls related to fiscal compliance and tax reporting. Monitor regulatory changes and ensure timely adjustments to internal processes. Participate in Tax Committees (Tax Reform, Optimization/Savings Projects, ABESPETRO). Safeguard good standing certifications and adherence to compliance requirements across all regulatory bodies.
  • Audit, Inspection & Authority Liaison - Manage responses to tax audits, fiscal inspections, official notices, and inquiries from authorities at all government levels. Coordinate documentation, supporting analyses, and interactions with external auditors and tax advisors.
  • Team Leadership & Vendor Oversight - Lead, mentor, and develop the Brazil fiscal compliance sub team. Oversee outsourced compliance and advisory service providers to ensure proper fiscal documentation (e.g., nota fiscal) retrieval, accuracy, quality, and adherence to cut off dates and tax calendar deadlines. Promote best practices, operational excellence, and continuous process improvement. Recruit, coach, and develop assigned personnel.
  • Perform miscellaneous tasks as required, including the preparation of slide presentations for senior management and other stakeholders' reviews.
Education
  • Minimum Required: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Law, or related field.
  • Preferred Level: Bachelor’s degree with Post‑Graduate specialization or MBA in Taxation, Accounting, Finance, or related discipline.
Experience
  • Minimum Required: 5+ years of experience in fiscal compliance and accounting operations within Brazil, including routine tax reporting, statutory filings, and tax accounting responsibilities. Demonstrated experience in cross‑functional collaboration.
  • Preferred Level: Supervisory experience in a multi‑entity or multi‑country financial reporting environment, with exposure to corporate‑level tax, treasury, and compliance processes.
Skills
  • Minimum Required: Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications; solid bookkeeping foundation; working knowledge of US GAAP/IFRS and Brazilian statutory accounting requirements; strong understanding of local fiscal and tax compliance rules. Must be proficient in written and spoken Portuguese and English.
  • Preferred Level: Hands‑on experience in full fiscal compliance preparation; advanced Excel skills; familiarity with ERP systems and tax compliance solutions; strong analytical and documentation abilities.

Para que tudo dê certo nas lojas, um time enorme trabalha na administração e no centro de distribuição. Isso significa que há muito espaço para quem quer fazer parte do nosso super time! Com a união dos dois negócios, nos tornamos ainda maiores. Hoje somos cerca de 5 mil colaboradores trabalhando diariamente para tornar a vida das famílias mais feliz. A marca conta com uma plataforma física, com diferentes modelos de lojas, um ecossistema de vendas digitais e um portfólio de serviços financeiros e marcas próprias que se complementam. Oferecemos aos nossos clientes os mais diversos produtos, a preços acessíveis, para equipar a casa e surpreender a família brasileira.

O nosso sonho grande é dobrar o tamanho da companhia em 5 anos, de forma rentável, surpreendendo os nossos clientes. E aí, você quer vir escrever essa história de sucesso junto com a gente?

At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President, Auditor to join our Internal Audit team. This role is located in Rio de Janeiro.

Responsibilities

  • Executing thorough and accurate testing to assess adherence to internal policies, audit standards, and applicable Brazilian and global regulatory requirements.
  • Identifying and promoting opportunities for the use of data analytics, automation, and AI to enhance audit coverage and efficiency.
  • Leads risk‑focused planning, fieldwork and reporting, in accordance with Internal Audit policies, methodologies, and standards to identify meaningful issues, risks and other exposures.

  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with key stakeholders across the Brazil businesses, second line functions, and global Internal Audit teams.
  • Apply knowledge of financial institutions and regulations daily, participate in relevant training, and share insights with the audit team.
  • Contributing to continuous risk assessment and monitoring activities, remaining alert to emerging risks and regulatory developments impacting the Brazil platform.
Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and work experience required.
  • Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related discipline.
  • Solid experience in Internal Audit or the relevant specialty area (Risk, Compliance, or Controls), with the ability to operate within a global audit framework.
  • Strong knowledge of the financial services industry, including preferably exposure to fund administration and/or custody activities.
  • Fluent English (written and spoken) to engage in audits, reporting, and collaboration with international stakeholders.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate issues and risks to stakeholders at different levels of seniority.
  • Additional skill requirements include understanding of the applied and interpretation of analytics results for Audit, critical thinking and problem solving.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work collaboratively, and exercise professional judgment.
  • Professional certifications (e.g., CIA, CPA, CFA) are preferred.

title: Coordenador de Planejamento e Controle
description:
O movimento da vida gera resultados e também resíduos.

Isso faz parte do ciclo natural de uma cidade viva e em constante transformação. Mas acreditamos que esses resíduos podem ter um destino melhor e possível continuando a gerar valor e mantendo a vida em movimento.

Foi com esse propósito que nasceu a Regenera Rio .

Uma empresa dedicada a transformar a forma como o Rio de Janeiro lida com seus resíduos, provenientes de residências, comércios e indústrias, garantindo um destino ambientalmente adequado. Tudo pensado para que o ciclo do saneamento básico seja completo: do transporte ao tratamento.

Um movimento que impulsiona a economia local, apoia a geração de empregos diretos e indiretos, fortalece a cadeia da reciclagem e contribui para uma cidade mais limpa e sustentável.

Essa transformação reduz os impactos ambientais causados pela destinação incorreta dos resíduos, promove melhorias diretas na saúde e na qualidade de vida da população carioca e impulsiona a economia circular, conectando pessoas, negócios e meio ambiente.

Missão do cargo:

Buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) de Planejamento e Controle para atuar de forma estratégica no processo de FP&A, com forte integração às áreas operacionais e papel essencial no suporte à tomada de decisão da alta administração, por meio de análises econômico-financeiras robustas e modelos financeiros complexos.

Principais Responsabilidades
  • Coordenar e acompanhar os processos de planejamento estratégico, orçamento anual, revisões periódicas (forecast) e controle orçamentário;
  • Desenvolver, estruturar e manter modelos financeiros complexos, incluindo:
  • Projeções financeiras de longo prazo;
  • Modelos de viabilidade econômico-financeira;
  • Simulações de cenários (sensibilidade, stress, upside e downside);
  • Modelos contratuais com múltiplos indexadores e diferentes estruturas de reajuste;
  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico das áreas operacionais, contratos, engenharia e comercial, traduzindo dados técnicos e operacionais em impactos financeiros claros e acionáveis;
  • Apoiar negociações contratuais, revisões de preços, pleitos e processos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro;
  • Estruturar, acompanhar e analisar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) financeiros e operacionais;
Requisitos técnicos
  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Economia, Administração, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
  • Sólida experiência em Planejamento e Controle Financeiro (FP&A);
  • Domínio avançado de modelagem financeira, especialmente em Excel (ou ferramentas equivalentes), incluindo:
  • Experiência com contratos de longo prazo, concessões ou setores intensivos em capital (infraestrutura, saneamento, resíduos, energia ou similares);
Diferenciais desejáveis
  • Experiência em empresas de infraestrutura, saneamento, meio ambiente ou serviços públicos;
  • Vivência com indexadores econômicos, reajustes contratuais e processos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro;
Atuamos na Região Metropolitana do Rio de Janeiro.

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!

Estamos presentes de forma estruturada e integrada na cidade do Rio de Janeiro e Região Metropolitana, com unidades operacionais localizadas em pontos estratégicos para o recebimento, transferência, tratamento e destinação ambientalmente adequada dos resíduos coletados.

Nosso compromisso é transformar a forma como os resíduos são geridos, criando valor ambiental, social e econômico a partir do que antes era descartado. Onde outros veem fim, nós enxergamos recomeço: onde tudo tenha a chance de se regenerar.

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff "for fit" makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture
Join Howard University and thrive with us! Job Purpose

The Senior People Operations Officer serves as the College’s principal operational administrator for all HR-, payroll-, and hiring-related transactions. This role ensures the accuracy, compliance, and timely processing of personnel actions for faculty, staff, adjuncts, student employees, wage workers, and stipend-supported personnel. The incumbent functions as the College’s primary point of coordination between CEA leadership, HR, Payroll, the Office of the Provost, and departmental administrators. This is not an HR strategic role; instead, it is a senior-level operational and transactional position responsible for end‑to‑end workflow execution, Workday processing, onboarding, offboarding, and compliance.

Supervisory Authority

Responsible for supervising the Budget Coordinator, Administrative III. Formally plans, assigns, directs, and evaluates work performed. Makes merit and promotion recommendations to the Dean and ensures professional development alignment with institutional expectations.

Nature And Scope

The Senior People Operations Officer interacts daily with academic departments, program directors, faculty, HR Business Partners, the Budget Office, Payroll, and the Office of the Provost. The incumbent must exercise a high degree of accuracy and judgment in handling sensitive personnel information, navigating complex approval processes, and ensuring compliance with University policy, hiring standards, and audit expectations.

Principal Accountabilities
  • Serve as the College’s senior Workday transaction specialist for all hires, job changes, faculty terminations, PAPs, compensation changes, funding changes, and academic appointments.
  • Coordinate all job posting requests with HR Recruiting and ensure funding alignment prior to submission.
  • Draft and monitor term sheets, offer letters (where applicable), hiring packets, and background check requirements.
  • Manage onboarding workflows including I‑9, tax documentation, direct deposit, employee access, and new employee orientation tracking.
  • Initiate and track offboarding workflows for employees, adjunct faculty, and student workers.
  • Ensure accurate student hiring through FRFs, HAFs, wage-hire classifications, and Workday setup.
  • Maintain weekly hiring and transaction status reports for CEA leadership.
  • Conduct monthly HR and payroll compliance audits including cost allocations, active/inactive positions, and pending transactions.

title: 2º Oficial de Máquinas
description:
Sobre a Log-In

BEM-VINDOS A BORDO! Aqui, na Log-In, somos um time formado por pessoas disruptivas, engajadas e apaixonadas que gerenciam e operam as melhores soluções logísticas integradas, conectando o Brasil e o Mercosul. Nascemos para movimentar mais do que cargas, movimentamos oportunidades e criamos soluções inteligentes e personalizadas.

Hoje somos mais de 1.000 corações que se destacam por unirem valores que inspiram a companhia. Por aqui, os valores são as diretrizes que traduzem aquilo em que acreditamos: simplicidade, atitude de dono, espírito de equipe, cliente no centro, segurança e foco em resultados.

Nossa cultura e o cuidado com a nossa gente nos transporta para posicionamentos ainda mais diversos, equitativos e inclusivos. O resultado de toda nossa dedicação é refletido em pesquisas de clima realizadas com nossos colaboradores. Em 2022, a Log-In conquistou, pelo segundo ano consecutivo, o selo de Great Place to Work® (GPTW). No mesmo ano, entramos no Ranking GPTW de melhores empresas para trabalhar do Espírito Santo e, em 2023, no Ranking de melhores empresas para trabalhar no Rio de Janeiro.

Uma conquista que nos orgulha e nos incentiva a continuar fazendo de tudo para ser um lugar cada vez melhor para as pessoas. Nossa jornada também é marcada pela inovação, responsabilidade e pelo compromisso com o meio ambiente.

Venha fazer parte do nosso time. Será um prazer ter você aqui com a gente.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Substituir o Subchefe (se for o mais antigo que se segue) na sua falta ou impedimento;
  • Fazer os quartos (encarregado do serviço de quarto de máquinas) e divisões para os que foi designado, dando imediato conhecimento ao Chefe ou Subchefe das ocorrências verificadas, fazendo o devido registro no ‘Diário de Máquinas’;
  • Dar cumprimento às ordens de serviço recebidas para a boa condução, conservação e limpeza de todos os motores e equipamentos, zelando pelo seu bom funcionamento;
  • Executar os serviços para os quais for designado pelo Chefe de Máquinas, tais como de encarregado dos motores, caldeiras, sistema elétrico, frigoríficas, bombas, aparelhos de governo, aparelhos de suspender e de movimentação de carga, sistema de óleo combustível e água de alimentação;
  • Incumbir-se dos serviços de reparo que possam ser feitos com recursos de bordo, além da conservação e ajustagem dos diversos equipamentos;
  • Responder pela guarda e conservação das ferramentas que lhe forem entregues, assinando a respectiva cautela e responsabilizando‑se pelas faltas que ocorrerem.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Ensino Superior Completo;
  • Regra: STCW A-III/2;
  • Toda certificação em dia;
  • Desejável experiência com navios de container;
  • Experiência prévia em navios;
  • CIR (Caderneta de Inscrição e Registro);
  • Comprovante de vacinação Covid‑19, do aplicativo Conect Sus com a 1°, 2°, 3° e 4° dose;
  • Certificado Internacional da Febre Amarela;
  • Passaporte válido;
  • EGPM;
  • HPAV1;
  • HPAV2;
  • TBS;
  • EESS;
  • ECIA;
  • EPSM;
  • EOPN;
  • Certificados NRs - Atualizados (NR33/ NR35/ NR20/NR06/NR10/ NR11/NR12).
Benefícios

O que a Log-In proporciona?

  • Pra cuidar da sua saúde física e mental:
    • Plano de saúde e Plano odontológico, extensivos a seus dependentes;
    • Programa Viva Bem: Com Atendimento focado na Saúde Física, Saúde Emocional e Saúde Social;
    • Programa Amor de Mãe - Programa de Gestantes | Amor de Mãe;
    • ️ Wellhub (Desconto em academias).
  • Pra apoiar seu dia a dia:
    • Auxílio Transporte (A cada embarque e desembarque);
    • Vale Alimentação. No Natal, recebemos o alimento em dobro;
    • Loginers: Oportunidade de trabalhar e trocar conhecimentos diários com um time incrível e acolhedor;
    • Ah! Por aqui comemoramos todas as grandes datas comemorativas.
  • Pra desenvolver sua carreira:
    • Construção de PDI (Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual) com sua liderança;
    • Cultura de feedback e desenvolvimento;
    • Treinamentos e acesso a Universidade Corporativa (Unilog‑In);
    • Ciclo de Gente: Com Avaliação de Desempenho anual;
    • Acompanhamentos de Metas.
  • Você no centro:
    • ️ Momento Terapêutico: O Momento Terapêutico une duas atividades, através de um intervalo focado em ginástica laboral e alongamentos;
    • Squad de Diversidade: Por aqui, somos todos plurais. Temos um grupo de pessoas que fomentam temas sobre diversidade, equidade e inclusão;
    • Programa Performance em Alto Mar;
    • Participação nos Resultados.

title: Manager, Risk Management, Intelligence & C4 (RiC4) FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description The position

The Manager, Risk Management, Intelligence & C4 (RiC4) is responsible for leading the structured identification, assessment, monitoring and mitigation of safety and security risks for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The role establishes and manages the tournament‑wide risk management framework, supports intelligence coordination and contributes to the development and implementation of the C4 (Command, Control, Communications and Computers) governance structure. The position ensures that risk‑informed decision‑making underpins all safety and security planning and operational activities across official tournament sites.

Key responsibilities
  • Develop and implement a formal risk and threat identification, assessment and prioritisation process for all official tournament sites and activities
  • Develop, maintain and continuously update the tournament‑wide security risk register, ensuring risks are tracked, assessed and mitigated throughout all phases of the event
  • Conduct risk assessment analyses for host cities, stadiums, non‑competition sites as well as other specific ancillary events, matches, sites or activities, and develop corresponding risk treatment action plans
  • Coordinate threat, intelligence and situational awareness inputs from domestic and international partners, ensuring structured analysis and dissemination
  • Continuously gather and analyse intelligence relevant to tournament operations and provide structured strategic and operational briefings to senior management and relevant functional areas
  • Support the design, implementation and continuous improvement of the C4 (Command, Control, Communications & Coordination) systems, ensuring alignment with the overall FWWC operational governance framework
  • Enable effective information flow to leadership and operational teams, including leading the daily reporting rhythms and information cycles as defined in the C4i concept
  • Develop standard operating protocols for escalating, responding to and monitoring operational risks
  • Assist in determining appropriate security assets and protective measures required to safeguard official sites and assets
  • Establish and maintain strong working relationships with domestic and, where required, international intelligence agencies and/or with the relevant FA Manager (Public Security) to support integrated security planning
  • Support and encourage the establishment of a Police Cooperation Centre (or equivalent mechanism) to enhance intelligence and information sharing among stakeholders
  • Monitor compliance with statutory, regulatory and organisational instruments relevant to risk management and security operations
  • Support and advise on background check protocols and related risk considerations in coordination with the Accreditation & Access functions
Your profile Education
  • University degree in security management, risk management, criminology, intelligence studies, public safety or a related field
Experience
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in risk management, intelligence coordination or security analysis, preferably within major events, public safety agencies or multi‑agency environments
  • Proven experience in developing and managing risk registers and structured risk assessment frameworks
  • Experience working with law enforcement, intelligence services or governmental security bodies in Brazil
  • Familiarity with command and control structures and operational coordination models
Skills & Competencies
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to synthesize complex information into actionable insights
  • High attention to detail and structured documentation capability
  • Ability to exercise discretion and handle sensitive information with integrity
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the preparation of strategic briefings
  • Ability to work collaboratively across multiple functional areas and external partners
  • Advanced IT proficiency including MS Office suite, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in Portuguese
Certifications & Requirements
  • Willingness to travel nationally and work extended hours during tournament periods
  • Fluency in Portuguese (spoken and written) is essential, English desirable
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.
About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Host City Manager - Brasília will be responsible for the institutional management of FIFA's relationship with the state and municipal governments of the respective Host City of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™.

Acting as the main local liaison, this professional will ensure the monitoring and coordination of government commitments under their responsibility, ensuring continuous alignment with FIFA's strategy and guidelines.

The position is preferably based in the Host City itself, ensuring local presence, institutional proximity, and direct monitoring of agendas.

The Manager will report directly to the Head of Government Relations and Host Cities.

The tournament will be staged across 8 stadiums in Brazil, and we’re recruiting the Host City Manager for Brasília.

Please apply only if you currently live in Brasília or can relocate there independently.

Key Responsibilities

Institutional Relations with State and Municipal Governments

  • Act as FIFA's main institutional representative to the State Government and City Hall of the Host City under your responsibility.
  • Maintain ongoing relationships with state and municipal secretariats, autonomous agencies, public companies, and other relevant local bodies.
  • Ensure that local authorities are aligned with the commitments made in the Host City Agreement and other instruments signed with FIFA.

Monitoring of Government Deliverables

  • Monitor and report on the status of state and municipal government obligations related to the tournament.
  • Identify risks, bottlenecks, and schedule deviations, proposing solutions and making the necessary adjustments.
  • Support, when applicable, the local coordination of thematic working groups (security, transportation, mobility, public services, among others).

Coordination with FIFA's Central Structure

  • Act as a link between the Host City and FIFA's functional areas (Security, Transportation, Operations, Sustainability, Communications, among others).
  • Ensure that local information and demands are reported in a structured and timely manner to the Head of the area.
  • Support the organization of technical visits, workshops, meetings, and official FIFA agendas in the Host City.

Planning, Reporting, and Governance

  • Prepare periodic reports on institutional relations and the status of the Host City's commitments.
  • Update reports, schedules, and monitoring tools defined by the Government Relations area.
  • Ensure institutional consistency, alignment of discourse, and adherence to FIFA guidelines at the local level.
  • Reporting and Governance
  • Coordinated action with other Host City Managers, ensuring standardization and an integrated vision of the project.
Your Profile

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in International Relations, Law, Public Administration, Communication, Political Science, or related fields.

Experience

  • Solid experience of at least 6 years in government relations, institutional coordination, or public stakeholder management, preferably in complex projects, large-scale events, or institutional environments.
  • Previous experience in large sport events or organizations with an international interface (FIFA, Local Organizing Committees, IOC, etc.).

Behavioral Competencies

  • Organization and method: Ability to structure processes, prioritize demands, and perform tasks efficiently.
  • Proactivity: Anticipation of management and head needs, with a focus on solutions.
  • Attention to detail: Rigorous with quality, consistency of information, and meeting deadlines.
  • Institutional communication: Clear oral and written communication, with tone and language appropriate to the institutional environment.

Differentials

Requirements

description:
Gerente de Projeto – AVSI Brasil – Rio de Janeiro

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

O Gerente de Projeto será responsável pela gestão integral do projeto garantindo o cumprimento das diretrizes contratuais e dos procedimentos da AVSI. Essa função abrange a coordenação completa do ciclo do projeto, integrando aspectos gerenciais e administrativos, com responsabilidade final pelo planejamento e execução das atividades, gerenciamento da equipe dedicada, mobilização das comunidades, suporte técnico e administrativo, além do desenvolvimento de metodologias de controle e logística para assegurar a execução eficiente e os resultados esperados.

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO:
  • Gerenciar o orçamento do programa, assegurando o uso eficiente dos recursos financeiros, acompanhando a execução orçamentária, controlando despesas, e garantindo o cumprimento das regras e diretrizes estabelecidas pelo contrato e pelos procedimentos da AVSI.
  • Organizar as atividades do projeto nos seus aspectos operacionais e administrativos, apresentando relatórios ao responsável preposto;
  • Auxiliar na solicitação de compras previstas no Plano de Aquisição aprovado, garantindo a correta descrição de bens e serviços para o setor de aquisições;
  • Selecionar, coordenar, supervisionar, monitorar e avaliar a equipe técnica do programa;
  • Aplicar rigorosamente os procedimentos e regras estabelecidos nos manuais da AVSI;
  • Manter atualizado o arquivo de documentos no sistema de PATRIMONIALIZAÇÃO da AVSI;
  • Enviar periodicamente ao setor de Comunicação materiais sobre o projeto para publicação;
  • Contribuir para a elaboração de documentos descritivos necessários à prestação de contas do projeto;
  • Representar a AVSI no diálogo e na relação técnica com a equipe da contratante;
  • Realizar missões e atividades em outros territórios ou escritórios da AVSI no Brasil, quando necessário;
  • Contribuir para a elaboração de relatórios internos destinados ao cliente;
  • Participar de reuniões e conferências periódicas, sempre que solicitado;
  • Desenvolver o programa de acordo com as especificações técnicas do contrato, respeitando prazos, escopo e conteúdos previamente estabelecidos;
  • Executar os processos necessários para a plena realização das atividades previstas no programa;
  • Gerenciar a execução técnica das atividades, assegurando que os conteúdos, metodologias, estruturas e equipamentos sejam aplicados de maneira favorável ao alcance dos objetivos propostos;
  • Coordenar a mobilização e promover o diálogo para engajamento do público-alvo;
  • Articular parcerias com outras organizações para fortalecer as ações do programa;
  • Organizar a logística de campo, elaborando documentos comprobatórios que evidenciem o desenvolvimento das atividades realizadas;
  • Participar de momentos formativos e de trabalhos propostos pela Organização;
  • Cumprir suas atribuições conforme descrição do cargo, Código de Ética e Conduta da AVSI Brasil, e Procedimentos Operacionais Interno;

  • Mapeamento de requisitos de negócios, entendimento de processos de negócios, estudo e análise de fluxos de trabalho e desenho de soluções.

  • Comunicar métricas diárias e relatar exceções a outros departamentos de Operações e em toda a Amazon, conforme necessário.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that – it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets – a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Team You’ll Work With

You’ll enter our engineering interview process as part of a pooled hiring model. We believe in hiring for Carta first, focusing on your core strengths and technical craft rather than a specific team’s immediate gap.

Staff Engineers at Carta are technical anchors for our business. You don’t just own features, you take long‑term accountability for the technical health and strategic direction of different domains. As you move through our process, we’ll transition from the general pool to a team‑matching phase. Our goal is to match your unique technical strengths, and personal career interests with our most impactful, strategic challenges.

Strategic areas you may influence
  • Platform Data Ecosystem: Shaping how data flows across our entire suite of products to ensure a "single source of truth" for private market data.
  • Financial Systems Architecture: Designing resilient, scalable solutions for management fee accounting and multi‑currency transactions.
  • Engineering Excellence: Defining company‑wide standards that reduce operational load and improve developer velocity across dozens of teams.
The Problems You’ll Solve

As a Staff Engineer, you are responsible for the long‑term technical health and success of your business unit. You’ll work to:

  • Navigate Ambiguity: Tackle the most complex and poorly defined problems at Carta, breaking them down into navigable paths for the rest of the organization.
  • Champion Systemic Improvement: Identify and eliminate failure patterns across multiple systems, driving architectural changes that improve scalability and reliability.
  • Bridge Technical Gaps: Use your deep understanding of cross‑functional domains to align multiple teams on major technical decisions.
  • Define the AI Frontier: Lead the charge in transforming how we build by defining the context and building the rails that allow every person at Carta to leverage AI tools safely and effectively. You’ll help move the organization toward a future where AI amplifies our collective engineering impact.
  • Uphold Engineering Standards: Set the vision for operational excellence and mentor senior engineers to raise the collective craft of the organization.
About You
  • The Tech Stack: You are an expert in building distributed systems. While our primary stack is Python/Django, React, and Postgres, you should be comfortable guiding technical direction across JVM languages, gRPC, and cloud‑native infrastructure (AWS).
  • Leadership: You lead through influence rather than authority, acting as a role model for constructive communication and technical discipline.
  • Vision: You don't just solve the problem in front of you; you anticipate future roadblocks and build systems that support long‑term business growth.
  • Experience: We recommend 10+ years of professional software engineering experience with a track record of high‑level technical leadership.
Disclosures

description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

Sobre a Função

Estamos em busca de um(a) Gerente Regional de Investigações Antifalsificação para integrar nossa equipe global de Group Security. A posição reporta-se ao(à) Líder Global de Antifalsificação (ACF) e tem como objetivo liderar a estratégia regional de combate à falsificação, protegendo nossa marca, nossos consumidores e nossa propriedade intelectual.

Esta é uma oportunidade para profissionais que desejam atuar em um ambiente diverso, colaborativo e com impacto real nos negócios, trabalhando em parceria com equipes internas, autoridades e parceiros externos em diferentes países da região.

Base: Rio de Janeiro ou São Paulo

Principais Responsabilidades

Liderança Estratégica

  • Colaborar com áreas internas como negócios, jurídico, assuntos corporativos e comunicação
  • Construir e manter parcerias com autoridades, entidades do setor e stakeholders estratégicos
  • Gerenciar fornecedores de serviços de investigação, promovendo eficiência, inovação e uso responsável do orçamento
  • Definir indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e acompanhar resultados
  • Comunicar avanços e insights de forma clara à liderança e às partes interessadas


Execução Operacional

  • Identificar mercados, produtos e riscos prioritários na região
  • Implementar estratégias regionais de antifalsificação alinhadas aos objetivos globais
  • Supervisionar investigações online e offline realizadas por parceiros externos
  • Desenvolver inteligência sobre tendências, rotas e novos métodos de falsificação
  • Atuar em conjunto com autoridades, alfândega e órgãos reguladores em ações de enforcement
  • Garantir conformidade com legislações internacionais de propriedade intelectual
  • Apoiar iniciativas legais relacionadas à falsificação
  • Gerenciar o orçamento regional do programa de antifalsificação
  • Avaliar resultados e ajustar estratégias quando necessário
  • Trabalhar com equipes de embalagem e negócio na adoção de tecnologias de autenticação de produtos


Engajamento e Desenvolvimento

  • Gerenciar o relacionamento com fornecedores externos de investigação
  • Desenvolver treinamentos regionais sobre riscos e prevenção à falsificação
  • Representar a Haleon em fóruns, eventos e grupos de trabalho do setor
  • Atuar como referência técnica para stakeholders internos na região


Qualificações

  • Experiência sólida (mín. 5 anos) em investigações, proteção de marca, antifalsificação ou enforcement de propriedade intelectual
  • Vivência com autoridades, alfândega e equipes jurídicas em contextos internacionais ou regionais
  • Experiência na gestão de investigações complexas e fornecedores externos
  • Conhecimento em leis de propriedade intelectual e tendências de falsificação
  • Certificações na área são um diferencial
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita
  • Ética, resiliência e senso de responsabilidade
  • Inglês avançado (obrigatório)


Competências Essenciais

  • Autonomia, organização e tomada de decisão responsável
  • Capacidade de atuar tanto de forma estratégica quanto prática
  • Habilidade para trabalhar com múltiplos stakeholders e equipes diversas
  • Experiência em gestão de orçamento e fornecedores
  • Mentalidade orientada a risco, aprendizado contínuo e melhoria constante
  • Capacidade de colaborar com pessoas de diferentes culturas, países e realidades


About The Role

As part of a global team within Group Security, the Anti-Counterfeit Regional Investigations Manager reports to the Global Lead for Anti-Counterfeiting (ACF). The main function of the role is to tactically develop and implement the ACF strategy, manage and supervise ACF Program investigations and activities in the designated geographic region to include country specific plans. Responsibilities include intelligence assessment, case selection, the management and oversight of anti-counterfeit investigations (online and offline), proactive investigation case management, to include the development and implementation of innovative approaches and investigative strategies to meet business needs.

The manager will collaborate with internal business stakeholders, law enforcement, legal teams, and external partners to drive enforcement actions and strategic initiatives. The role ensures the protection of the company’s intellectual property, brand integrity, and consumer trust by identifying, investigating, and mitigating counterfeit activities.

Location: Rio de Janeiro or Sao Paulo

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop operational relationships with key internal stakeholders including business, legal, corporate affairs, and corporate communications
  • Develop and maintain strategic relationships with law enforcement agencies, industry bodies, regulatory authorities, and peer organizations
  • Build and maintain strategic and tactical investigation service supplier relationships, promoting innovation, responsiveness, cost optimization, return on investment (ROI), and continuous improvement
  • Develop KPIs and reporting frameworks to measure program effectiveness and return on investment (ROI)
  • Provide regular updates to senior leadership and stakeholders


Operational Execution

  • Conduct risk assessments to identify high-risk markets and products
  • Develop and implement regional anti-counterfeit strategies aligned with global brand protection goals
  • Provide instruction and guidance to external investigation suppliers based on the strategic direction set by the Global Program Lead
  • Provide effective case management oversight and direction by working with external investigation suppliers to ensure investigations are conducted and reported efficiently and in accordance with Haleon’s ACF Program Strategy
  • Develop intelligence strategies to identify and monitor counterfeiting trends
  • Oversee regional monitoring of counterfeit activities across online and offline channels
  • Implement a regional customs strategy to identify key strategic ports and counterfeiting routes, product authentication training opportunities, and intelligence dissemination practices
  • Coordinate with law enforcement, customs, regulatory bodies, and industry coalitions to pursue and, when appropriate attend, enforcement actions
  • Ensure ACF Program compliance with international IP laws and regulations
  • Support litigation efforts related to counterfeit activities
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of counterfeit trends and regulatory changes
  • Manage the regional anti-counterfeit program budget, ensuring effective forecasting, spend control, and ROI
  • Monitor and evaluate enforcement outcomes and adjust strategies accordingly
  • Identify and report counterfeiting developments and techniques which undermine product security
  • Work with packaging design and business teams to evaluate and implement product authentication technologies (e.g., serialization, digital watermarking, blockchain).


Stakeholder Engagement and Training

  • Manage relationships with external investigation service suppliers
  • Develop regional training programs to educate stakeholders on counterfeiting risks and mitigation opportunities
  • Represent Haleon at regional industry forums, conferences and working groups to share intelligence, benchmark practices, and influence standards
  • As a subject matter expert, support a regional network of non-ACF champions embedded across business units and functions


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in law enforcement investigations, brand protection, anti-counterfeiting, or IP enforcement
  • Experience of working with law enforcement, customs, and legal teams across international jurisdictions
  • Proven experience in investigating and managing complex proactive investigations and enforcements
  • Demonstrated success in managing third-party investigation service suppliers and operational budgets
  • Professional certification such as Interpol Intellectual Property (IP) Crime College or recognized university anti-counterfeit or intellectual property program accreditation strongly preferred
  • Strong understanding of IP laws, counterfeit trends, and enforcement mechanisms
  • Exceptional written/oral communication
  • High ethical standards, discretion, and resilience under pressure


Core Competencies

  • Self-motivated and able to act independently and responsibly demonstrating sound and ethical judgment
  • Ability, at both a strategic and tactical level, to identify and manage ACF related issues and customize, implement, and execute solutions
  • Strong commercial acumen and budget/vendor management experience
  • Risk-based thinking and continuous improvement
  • Stakeholder engagement
  • Demonstrate ability to work with a wide range of individuals from diverse backgrounds, countries of origin, and at varying levels within the corporate structure


Job Posting End Date

Equal Opportunities

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.

During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.

The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

Adjustment or Accommodations Request

If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.

Note to candidates

The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Piloto de ROV - Subsea (Embarcado)
description:
Join to apply for the Piloto de ROV – Subsea (Embarcado) role at OceanPact Serviços Marítimos

Sobre a OceanPact

A OceanPact é uma empresa brasileira especializada em serviços marítimos, atuando com excelência nas áreas de meio ambiente, engenharia e logística offshore. Com presença sólida no mercado e atuação em todo o território nacional, oferecemos soluções integradas e sustentáveis para os desafios do mar. Nosso propósito é transformar o cuidado com o mar em valor para todos.

Sobre a vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Piloto de ROV para atuar em operações submarinas, assegurando a execução com segurança das manutenções dos equipamentos de ROV, além de realizar pilotagem e suporte técnico às operações offshore. Essa posição é estratégica para garantir a eficiência operacional, a segurança dos envolvidos e a excelência em entregas subsea .

Responsabilidades
  • Executar manutenções preventivas e corretivas dos sistemas de ROV, conforme planejamento das operações.
  • Pilotar, lançar e recolher o ROV, assegurando segurança e qualidade nas operações.
  • Utilizar equipamentos auxiliares de navegação e operar manipuladores quando necessário.
  • Realizar pré e pós-dive, instalar/remover equipamentos e ferramentas de acordo com as demandas.
  • Preencher o dive log e registrar manutenções realizadas.
  • Gravar e editar imagens/áudios conforme necessidade dos projetos.
  • Distribuir tarefas e orientar trainees de ROV, garantindo execução segura e eficaz.
  • Participar ativamente de todas as atividades relacionadas à segurança e SMS.
Requisitos
  • Ensino médio concluído e formação técnica em eletrônica, mecânica, eletrotécnica ou mecatrônica (CFT ativo).
  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência comprovada em operações submarinas como piloto de ROV (RSV, AHTS, DSV ou PLSV).
  • Conhecimento em hidráulica ou elétrica.
  • Pacote Microsoft Office.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de ROV Triton XLX, XLX EVO ou XLX-C.
  • Conhecimento em fibra óptica.
  • Conhecimento em LARS ODIM ou Dynacom.
  • Certificações atualizadas: CBSP, NR-10 e NR-35.
Local de trabalho
  • Modalidade: Embarcado – Bases offshore
  • Disponibilidade para embarques e regime offshore.
O que buscamos
  • Dá pra fazer, com responsabilidade e qualidade
  • O jeito certo: ética, segurança e excelência
  • Gostamos do que fazemos: entusiasmo e envolvimento
  • Confiança: relações transparentes e comprometidas
  • Inovação: melhoria contínua e novas ideias
  • Resultados: foco em entregas com valor
O que oferecemos
  • Pacote de remuneração compatível com o mercado, com salário fixo e benefícios competitivos
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico, para você e sua família, porque cuidar de quem cuida importa
  • Vale-alimentação
  • Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, seguro e ético, onde o cuidado com as pessoas e o mar são levados a sério
  • Oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento profissional, com participação em projetos relevantes, treinamentos e contato com equipes multidisciplinares
  • Cultura forte e propósito claro, em uma empresa brasileira sólida, que cresce com responsabilidade e inovação
  • Estabilidade e confiança, em uma organização que atua com excelência e compromisso no setor marítimo e offshore
